23acfa9a1c0b5df6.description: Job Summary: PayLink is seeking a Risk Manager to lead its Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function as an independent control function. You will develop and maintain the risk management framework, assess risks across the business, and provide clear insights that support informed decisions, business resilience, and compliance with applicable Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements. The role works closely with senior management, relevant committees, and departmental risk owners while maintaining independent oversight and clear accountability. Key Responsibilities: 1. Governance, Strategy and Risk Management Framework Develop and update the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, policies, methodologies, tools and templates, and submit them for approval under the delegation of authority. Prepare an annual risk management strategy and work plan aligned with the Company’s strategy, license category and scale of operations. Define roles, responsibilities, escalation lines, risk owners and control owners in coordination with relevant departments, without imposing unapproved operational authority. Support the Risk Committee and relevant committees by preparing materials and reports and tracking decisions within each committee’s mandate. Review the framework periodically following product, business model or regulatory changes or material events. 2. Risk Identification, Assessment and Risk Register Lead enterprise assessments of inherent and residual risk in collaboration with departmental risk owners. Establish and maintain the enterprise risk register, documenting causes, impacts, controls, assessments, treatment owners and target dates. Coordinate Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) and challenge the reasonableness of assessments against available evidence. Assess enterprise risks arising from new products and services, material changes, projects, expansion and partnerships before recommendations are submitted. Conduct scenario analyses and stress testing in line with priorities, capabilities and available data, in coordination with Finance, Operations and Technology. 3. Risk Appetite, Indicators and Reporting Develop and review the risk appetite statement and tolerance limits in coordination with Finance, Compliance, Operations, Cybersecurity and other stakeholders, and submit them to the authorized approving body. Develop a proportionate set of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), defining data sources, data owners, measurement frequency and alert thresholds. Monitor risk appetite breaches, analyze their causes, recommend mitigation and escalate under approved authorities. Produce concise periodic reports for senior management and relevant committees on material risks, trends, breaches, remediation plans and decisions required. 4. Control Assessment and Independent Challenge Assess control design adequacy and effectiveness from a risk management perspective, using supporting evidence, test results, reports, interviews and appropriate samples. Request information and evidence necessary for risk assessments within approved access rights, need-to-know principles, confidentiality and data protection requirements. Document professional disagreements with risk or control owners and escalate material matters through approved channels. Do not operate controls, make specialist operational decisions or substitute for Internal Audit’s independent assurance role. 5. Financial, Operational, Technology and Financial Crime Risks Monitor risks relating to liquidity, settlements, partner banks, fraud, operations, third parties, concentration, reputation and strategy in coordination with their respective owners. Assess cybersecurity and technology risks within the enterprise framework in coordination with Cybersecurity and Technology, without assuming their specialist or operational responsibilities. Include money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing risks in the enterprise risk register and independently challenge exposures, controls and residual risk in coordination with Compliance and the AML officer. Access appropriate transaction, alert and suspicion-related indicators for risk assessment, subject to confidentiality restrictions on reports and protected case files; this role does not include investigating individual cases or making regulatory reporting decisions. Ensure enterprise assessments align with specialist risk assessments without creating conflicting assessments or transferring ownership of specialist programs to Risk Management. 6. Business Continuity and Crisis Management Oversee the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework and program through the Business Continuity Officer and relevant functions, monitoring plans, testing and remediation readiness. Review Business Impact Analysis (BIA) results, verify business owners’ validation of impacts and dependencies, and confirm that Technology and Operations have assessed recovery target feasibility. Monitor business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management plans and tests, while operational response and recovery remain with designated teams. Report material readiness gaps to senior management and relevant committees, coordinating with Compliance on regulatory notifications. 7. Third Parties, Changes and Projects Assess risks relating to suppliers, outsourcing, third-party dependencies, concentration and single points of failure in collaboration with relationship owners. Review risks associated with projects, material changes and new services and provide recommendations before approval. Track risk mitigation plans, action owners and deadlines without executing other departments’ remedial actions. 8. Regulatory Requirements, Coordination and Awareness Monitor regulatory requirements applicable to the risk management function and compile supporting evidence with Compliance and relevant stakeholders. Participate in supervisory visits and respond on enterprise risk management topics using validated information, referring specialist technical topics to their owners. Track regulatory and Internal Audit findings relevant to Risk Management and verify remediation by responsible owners. Deliver practical risk awareness and training to risk owners and promote risk culture throughout the Company. Maintain orderly records of evidence, assessments, reports, decisions and relevant correspondence. Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is preferred. Preferably at least seven years of relevant experience in risk management, governance, or financial services, including leadership experience, subject to applicable fit-and-proper requirements. Practical experience within financial institutions or payment service providers supervised by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). Working knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), risk appetite, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Business Continuity Management (BCM), internal controls, and regulatory reporting. Relevant professional credentials, such as FRM, CRMP, RIMS-CRMP, or an ISO 31000-related qualification, are preferred and complement practical experience. Strong analytical judgment and independent assessment skills, with the ability to connect risk exposures to business objectives and regulatory impact. Effective communication, cross-functional coordination, and professional conflict management skills. Ability to prepare clear executive reports and provide practical, actionable recommendations. Strong planning and prioritization skills, including tracking remediation activities within available resources. Ability to evaluate evidence and data while maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive information. Leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to strengthen risk culture and influence stakeholders without direct line authority.

2355597545c62324.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات الخزان الطبي في الرياض عن أخصائي تقنية إشعاعية للانضمام إلى فريقه. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تجهيز المرضى للتصوير، وإجراء التصوير الشعاعي، وضمان جودة الصور، بالإضافة إلى حفظ وتوثيق المواد والتقارير الطبية ذات الصلة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المرضى للتصوير وتهيئتهم وفقاً للأوضاع السليمة، وتحديد واختيار الوسائل الوقائية المناسبة. تشغيل أجهزة التصوير الشعاعي وتصوير الحالات المختلفة للمرضى والمصابين، مع مراقبة حالتهم أثناء وبعد التصوير. تفقد وتجهيز أجهزة التحميض، وفحص الصور، وإجراء التحليل الأولي لضمان جودة التصوير. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في تقنيات التصوير بالأشعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتصوير الإشعاعي، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ جميع أعمال التصوير بالأشعة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تقنية الإشعاع. القدرة على التعامل مع أجهزة التصوير الشعاعي المختلفة. فهم جيد لمبادئ السلامة الإشعاعية وتطبيقها. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد المرضى وتصويرهم. مهارات المراقبة والتقييم لجودة الصور الشعاعية. القدرة على توثيق وحفظ التقارير الطبية بدقة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي تقنية الإشعاع ضمن فريق مجمع عيادات الخزان الطبي في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في العيادات لتقديم الخدمات الإشعاعية للمرضى والمصابين. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

23ad08d75260a02c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نافذة الخليج للمقاولات عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ ومتابعة العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية، وضمان تطبيق السياسات والإجراءات الداخلية بما يتوافق مع نظام العمل السعودي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة وتنفيذ جميع المعاملات والإجراءات المتعلقة بوزارة الموارد البشرية والتنمية الاجتماعية (مكتب العمل)، وضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح المعمول بها. إدارة ومتابعة خدمات منصة قوى، بما يشمل توثيق عقود العمل وتجديدها، ونقل خدمات الموظفين، وتحديث البيانات الوظيفية، ومتابعة رخص العمل. التعامل مع المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية (GOSI)، بما يشمل تسجيل الموظفين واستبعادهم، وتحديث بياناتهم وأجورهم، ومتابعة الاشتراكات والتأكد من دقة المعلومات. متابعة معاملات الموظفين عبر المنصات الحكومية ذات العلاقة، والتنسيق مع الجهات المختصة لإنجاز الإجراءات المطلوبة. مراقبة حضور وانصراف الموظفين، ومتابعة التأخير والغياب وإعداد التقارير الدورية. إدارة طلبات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة، والتأكد من تطبيق السياسات الداخلية ونظام العمل السعودي. إعداد وتحديث ملفات الموظفين وسجلاتهم الوظيفية، وضمان دقة البيانات وسريتها. إعداد الخطابات والتعريفات الوظيفية والمستندات والنماذج المتعلقة بشؤون الموظفين. استقبال استفسارات الموظفين وشكاواهم ومتابعة معالجتها بالتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. متابعة تواريخ انتهاء العقود ورخص العمل والإقامات والوثائق الوظيفية، واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة لتجديدها في الوقت المناسب. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية والمعاملات الحكومية ورفعها إلى الإدارة المختصة. الالتزام بالأنظمة والتشريعات العمالية المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية، وضمان تنفيذ الإجراءات وفق السياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. معرفة قوية بنظام العمل السعودي واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المنصات الحكومية مثل "قوى" والمؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. دقة عالية في إدخال البيانات وإعداد التقارير. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع الموظفين والجهات الحكومية. القدرة على حل المشكلات والتعامل مع الشكاوى بمهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل ديناميكي يدعم العمليات الإدارية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

23deeac596649d89.description: About the Role Sasorisoft is seeking five Voice Over Artists to contribute to a commercial video game project. This is a contract position based in Saudi Arabia, requiring remote work. We are looking for performers interested in a long-term collaboration across multiple recording sessions throughout the game’s production, with an expected experience level of 0-1 years. Project Details This role involves voicing main characters for a commercial video game developed by Sasorisoft. The project requires five voice roles: two male and three female. The primary performance language is Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), with remote recording sessions scheduled in advance and agreed upon. Key Requirements Fluency in Arabic is mandatory, with the ability to perform naturally and clearly in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). A light regional accent is acceptable if clarity is maintained. Proficiency in English is required for communication and understanding recording directions. Strong acting ability with an expressive, theatrical vocal performance. Performances must convey emotional depth, character, and dynamic vocal expression, avoiding flat or monotonous delivery. Ability to convey a range of emotions, including confidence, anger, fear, sadness, pain, and determination. Ability to adjust vocal tone, intensity, pacing, and delivery according to the character and scene. Willingness to receive direction and perform revisions as necessary. Ability to maintain consistent character voice across multiple recording sessions. Professional communication and reliability. Remote Recording Setup Applicants must have a suitable microphone and a quiet recording environment capable of producing clean, high-quality audio. Actors are expected to record locally using appropriate audio recording software. Final audio must be delivered as uncompressed WAV files, adhering to technical specifications provided by the development team. Discord or a similar platform may be used for communication and live performance direction during recording sessions; Discord audio itself will not be accepted as the final recording. Actors must be able to record multiple takes of a line when required. Compensation Compensation for this role is 700 SAR per recording hour. This compensation covers acting performance, local recording using the actor’s own equipment, and delivery of audio files according to agreed specifications. Any additional requirements, including pickups and revisions, will be discussed and defined in the agreement prior to production. Application Process Interested candidates should provide the following information: Name or professional stage name. Brief introduction and any voice acting experience. Arabic MSA voice sample. A short acting sample demonstrating expressive, theatrical performance (avoiding flat or monotonous delivery). Confirmation of English proficiency. Confirmation of ability to record locally and deliver uncompressed WAV files. Contact information.

23f63666358c5238.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سرايا طويق للمقاولات عن فني إنشاءات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الأبنية، بما في ذلك جمع العينات ومطابقة المواصفات وتقدير الكميات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة مهندس الأبنية في إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالمعاينة ومتابعة التنفيذ وضبط الجودة. أخذ عينات من تربة موقع البناء ومواد الإنشاء والخلطات الإسمنتية، وإرسالها إلى المختبر لمطابقة المواصفات. تفقد العمل في إنشاء الأبنية أثناء وبعد عملية الإنشاء للتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة. المشاركة في قياس العمل المنجز بالتنسيق المباشر مع المهندس المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإنشاءات أو دور فني ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الأبنية. معرفة جيدة بجمع عينات التربة والمواد الإنشائية وإرسالها للمختبر. القدرة على مطابقة المواصفات الفنية وتقدير كميات المواد والعمالة اللازمة. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة يقع مقر هذه الوظيفة في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات العمل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم.

232c5a8bab8e90be.description: About the Role Plaza Premium Group is seeking a Lounge in Charge to oversee lounge operations in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing daily activities during assigned shifts and acting as the primary operational lead in the absence of the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager. The successful candidate will ensure high service standards, guest satisfaction, and operational efficiency while complying with company policies and local regulations. Key Responsibilities Act as Lounge In-Charge during assigned shifts, making operational decisions when the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager is absent. Supervise all lounge functions, including reception, F&B, and housekeeping, to ensure seamless operations. Oversee guest check-in and admission procedures in accordance with company policies. Professionally greet, receive, and bid farewell to guests. Handle guest enquiries, feedback, and complaints, ensuring prompt resolution and service recovery. Support and guide Guest Service Officers in daily operations and customer interactions. Monitor lounge areas to ensure cleanliness, comfort, and readiness. Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, and kitchen teams to resolve operational or service issues. Oversee cash handling, billing, and accurate record-keeping. Ensure proper handling and documentation of lost and found items. Monitor adherence to service standards, grooming, and conduct of guest service staff. Assist in staff scheduling, attendance monitoring, and shift handovers. Ensure confidentiality of guest information and operational data. Support training and on-the-job coaching for new and existing guest service staff. Prepare basic operational reports and escalate issues to management as needed. Conduct lounge opening and closing procedures, ensuring full readiness before operating hours. Monitor lounge capacity and guest flow, managing peak periods to maintain service standards. Handle incidents and emergencies, liaising with airport authorities, airlines, and partners. Monitor inventory levels and coordinate stock requisitions with relevant departments. Perform ad-hoc duties as assigned by the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager. Qualifications and Experience A Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in guest service, hospitality, or airport lounge operations, with supervisory exposure. Required Skills Strong customer service orientation with effective problem-solving skills. Ability to lead, motivate, and support service teams in a fast-paced environment. Capability to independently manage lounge operations and make sound decisions during assigned shifts. Good knowledge of service standards and guest handling procedures. Proficiency in handling cash transactions and maintaining accurate records. Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays. Professional appearance, positive attitude, and strong interpersonal skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, requiring active supervision of lounge operations and coordination with various teams to ensure a premium guest experience. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

2332671f822aa98e.description: About the Role Khidmah is seeking a Facilities Engineer to join its Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) Services Division in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the operational direction of facilities and engineering services, working with outsourced service providers to ensure robust engineering management systems are in place. The primary objective is to maintain a safe environment and achieve superior performance across properties. Key Responsibilities Oversee Low Voltage (LV) Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM), corrective, and reactive maintenance, including electrical preventive maintenance services. Monitor High Voltage (HV) assets such as switchgear, transformers, and DC systems, as well as backup power assets like UPS and generators. Attend major breakdowns and troubleshoot complex MEP systems, including chillers, cooling towers, pumps, BMS, AHU, FAHU, FCU, firefighting networks, and chilled water loops. Operate and maintain Building Management Systems (BMS) and access control/intercom systems. Plan, schedule, and review day-to-day MEP operations, subcontractor works, and site inspections to ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Prepare maintenance schedules, incident/accident reports, technical evaluations, and quotations. Track work orders, materials, and completion timelines using SAP. Coordinate with HSE to prepare risk assessments, method statements, risk management plans, and fire assessment plans, adhering to safety, business continuity, and information security policies. Maintain flexibility to work shift patterns and provide 24/7 standby availability for emergency call-outs. Qualifications and Experience A Diploma or Bachelor's degree (preferred) in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil specializations), Facilities Management, or a related field. FM-related professional certifications are an advantage. 6 to 9 years of experience within the relevant FM industry. Solid background in installation, maintenance, and repair across large commercial, retail, or residential premises. Required Skills and Knowledge Hands-on experience with Computer Aided Facilities Management (CAFM) systems, SAP, MS Office, and Project Management Software. Comprehensive understanding of Workplace Health and Safety (WH&S) regulations, permit-to-work systems, risk assessments, and water treatment management. Application Khidmah invites accomplished engineering professionals ready to drive operational excellence in facilities management to apply for this role.

2336b88726782dc5.description: In this role, you will lead the development and delivery of marketing plans for assigned residential projects, from positioning and go-to-market strategy through launch and ongoing campaigns. You will work closely with development, sales, commercial, brand and customer experience teams to bring compelling residential propositions to market. Develop and execute marketing strategies and go-to-market plans for residential developments. Define compelling positioning, value propositions, target audiences and key messaging for assigned projects. Plan and manage residential launches across pre-launch, launch and post-launch phases. Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, media, content, PR, events and activations. Partner closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align marketing activity with sales and customer acquisition objectives. Monitor residential market trends, customer behavior and competitor activity to identify opportunities and strengthen market positioning. Develop marketing collateral and customer-facing materials to support residential launches and sales activities. Coordinate with Residential Development, Masterplanning, District Marketing, Brand and Customer Experience teams. Manage creative, media and specialist agencies to ensure high-quality and timely delivery. Monitor campaign and marketing performance against agreed KPIs and recommend optimization opportunities. Manage marketing budgets, project timelines and key deliverables. Ensure all activities align with the overall residential portfolio strategy and Qiddiya brand. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Real Estate or a related field. 5-7 years of relevant marketing experience, ideally within residential real estate, property development, destinations or mixed-use developments. Demonstrated experience in residential launches, go-to-market planning and integrated marketing campaigns. Strong understanding of customer segmentation, positioning and proposition development. 239e97f44e78df33.description: Job Description The Turbine & Precision Equipment Rigger is responsible for executing highly critical, heavy, and precision lifting operations during power plant turbine outages and industrial maintenance shutdowns. This role demands exceptional technical expertise to safely handle multi-million dollar rotating equipment, gas/steam turbine components, and delicate machinery within tightly restricted spaces. The successful candidate must strictly adhere to engineered lifting plans, maintain zero-compromise safety standards, and display flawless precision under fast-paced outage timelines. Key Responsibilities Rigging Execution: Safely attach, lift, guide, and position heavy turbine components and associated mechanical equipment in strict compliance with approved, engineered lifting plans . Pre-Lift Assessment: Thoroughly review critical technical parameters prior to every lift, including total load weight, exact center of gravity , designated lifting points, travel path clearances, and final landing arrangements. Equipment Management: Select, calculate, and inspect specialized rigging hardware such as synthetic/wire-rope slings, shackles, spreader beams , chain blocks, and specialized lifting accessories. Compliance & Safety Verification: Audit all lifting tackle before use to verify valid identification tags, current inspection status, and Working Load Limits (WLL) . Precision Maneuvering: Expertly guide immense structural loads through highly restricted areas and congested plant environments utilizing controlled mechanical methods and precise signaling. Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years of proven experience as an industrial rigger, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed major turbine outages, power plant shutdowns, or heavy mechanical maintenance . Technical Skills: Comprehensive knowledge of rigging mathematics, center-of-gravity calculations, crane signals, and rigging hardware capacities. Certifications: Valid third-party rigging certifications (such as TUV, Bureau Veritas, Aramco, or equivalents ) are highly preferred. Physical Capability: Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and handle the physical demands of 12-hour shifts typical during emergency or scheduled outages. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork orientation, high attention to detail, and a strict commitment to safety protocols.

236323a3ffddfbef.job_title: Senior Systems Engineer for Threat Discrimination

239101eecde42af0.job_title: Staff Product Manager - Shipping and Fulfillment
239101eecde42af0.description: About the Role Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla, and every order they win ends the same way: something physical has to reach a customer. Shipping is where the platform stops being software. This role owns the shipping stack end to end and the economics underneath it: courier integrations, routing, cash-on-delivery reconciliation, exceptions, and partner performance, plus how far past last-mile delivery we go into inventory placement, warehousing, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, and returns. You lead a dedicated engineering squad as its one accountable product owner, and you own what a shipment costs and what the platform keeps on it. Few product roles let you own a merchant experience and its unit economics at the same time. This one does. You will drive impact across four major domains: Shipping Products (routing, label issuance, cash on delivery, tracking, driver-facing tools) Partner Integrations (provider onboarding, interface quality, status mapping, reconciliation, platform stability) Fulfillment Beyond Last Mile (inventory placement, warehousing and third-party orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, returns) Shipping Economics (carrier mix, rate card design, cost per successful delivery, what the platform charges and what it keeps) Responsibilities: Own the strategy and roadmap for shipping and fulfillment, prioritized on merchant retention and contribution per shipment, not feature count. Decide how each order is routed and priced: which provider carries it, at what service level, at what cost, and what the merchant pays. Raise delivery reliability where it is measurable: first-attempt success, service-level accuracy, exception rate, return to origin, and cash-on-delivery reconciliation. Build the integration layer that makes onboarding a new provider fast and keeps it stable once live: status mapping, retries, fallbacks, monitoring. Extend the product past last-mile delivery, choosing capabilities on merchant retention impact rather than on integration ease. Decide which shipping capability is free and which is paid, and defend where the line sits. Own the metrics with the data team, and move volume between providers when the performance data says to. Proven ownership of a shipping, fulfillment, or order-management product on a platform serving many businesses at once, with the numbers you moved: delivery success rate, service-level accuracy, exception rate, cash-on-delivery accuracy, or cost per shipment. Commercial fluency in shipment economics: you have built, priced, or renegotiated a rate card, and can explain how zone, weight, service level, cash on delivery, surcharges, and failed deliveries move cost per parcel. Depth past last-mile delivery in at least two of: inventory placement, warehousing or third-party fulfillment orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, reverse logistics, cross-border. Technical grounding in integrations: interfaces, webhooks, status mapping, retries, reconciliation. You can explain how a courier integration actually breaks and what made yours stable long term. Experience as the single product owner for a dedicated engineering squad, working across operations, commercial, and support rather than around them. Strongly preferred: you have built product on top of a partner network, where the company sold partner capacity and built its own capability alongside it. Seven or more years in product management. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English is required, and GCC logistics context is preferred over theoretical knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia.

234fcfe6034d01f8.description: The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations. The role oversees the receipt, inspection, classification, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous materials while ensuring compliance with local and international chemical safety regulations. The Warehouse Chemist provides technical expertise to support warehouse operations, minimize risks, maintain regulatory compliance, and promote best practices in chemical management. The position also supports audits, emergency response activities, and continuous improvement initiatives related to hazardous materials management. Key Responsibilities Receive, inspect, identify, classify, and verify chemicals and dangerous goods to ensure compliance with purchase specifications and regulatory requirements. Ensure the safe storage, segregation, handling, and transportation of chemicals in accordance with applicable safety standards and regulations. Conduct routine inspections of chemical storage areas and recommend corrective actions to address safety, environmental, and compliance risks. Monitor chemical inventory, shelf life, storage conditions, and maintain accurate records, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and regulatory documentation. Assess chemical compatibility and perform risk assessments to minimize hazards and support safe warehouse operations. Coordinate the safe disposal of expired, obsolete, or hazardous chemicals in compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements. Provide technical guidance and awareness training to warehouse personnel on chemical safety, hazardous material handling, PPE, and emergency response procedures. Collaborate with Procurement, HSE, Logistics, and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance, support audits, investigate incidents, and continuously improve chemical management practices. Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory Science, Chemical Technology, or a related scientific discipline. Minimum of four (4) years of experience in chemical warehouse operations, hazardous materials management, laboratory, or industrial chemical environments. Strong knowledge of chemical properties, hazard classification, compatibility, and hazardous material handling practices. Familiarity with applicable regulations, including GHS, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), IMDG Code, ADR, and local regulatory requirements. Proficiency in interpreting and applying Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and implementing safe chemical storage and segregation practices. Experience conducting chemical risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Good understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management systems, hazardous waste management, and environmental compliance. Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and warehouse management systems.

Support audits and ensure compliance with internal and external financial regulations. Bachelor’s degree (required) in Finance or Accounting (preferred). Master’s degree in Finance (preferred). Professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA) are an advantage. Minimum 6 years of experience, with at least 3 years in a lead role. Proven experience in the healthcare sector finance, insurance, or revenue cycle management. Strong background in financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting. Hands-on experience with insurance claim processes, validation, and reconciliation. Demonstrated experience in preparing, managing, and monitoring budgets within a healthcare environment.
